title: Downtown Concord Dirt Deal: Shovel-Ready 230-Unit Project Hits the Market - NewsBreak
text:
By Emily Johnson ,
3 days ago A coveted slice of downtown Concord that is already teed up for roughly 230 apartments just hit the open market, giving developers an unusually clean shot at building near BART without years of political trench warfare. The roughly 2.3-acre cluster of parcels at Salvio Street and Willow Pass Road comes with entitlements and renderings in hand, setting it up as one of the fastest paths to new housing within walking distance of the Concord BART station.
